title: VerificationVerdict
description: One independent verifier's verdict on ONE finding (Act I) or ONE edit (Act II), from ONE angle. Many of these — from different angles, by blind subagents — must clear before a finding/edit is delivered (grounding rule 8). Aggregation is done in code, not by an LLM.

target_id.description: The finding id or edit id being judged.

angle.description: Act-I angles: quote-locator, logical-validity, factual-literature, severity-calibration, decision-relevance, fix-safety, steelman-charity. Act-II adds: numeric-provenance, consistency, integrity, and human-voice (does a prose edit read as the author, not AI; a hard gate on writing-lane edits).

verdict.description: upheld = stands as written; upheld-with-revision = correct but the suggested_revision should be applied (e.g. severity down to Medium); rejected = should not be delivered; cant-tell = insufficient basis (does not block, but is recorded).

reason.description: Grounded, specific. For a rejection, say exactly why; for a revision, exactly what.

suggested_revision.description: The concrete change, e.g. 'severity High->Medium: result survives the robustness check in Table 6', or null.
